mutations.description: Reads with TanStack useQuery (cached, deduped, stale-while-revalidate); writes with useMutation — optimistic update, automatic rollback on error, then cache invalidation. Compare with the hand-rolled useOptimisticToggle on the Users page.
mutations.chaosHint: Toggles fail ~30% of the time (server-side) so you can watch the optimistic update roll back. Tune MUTATION_FAIL_RATE in server/utils/chaos.ts.
